```text
    94→<script setup lang="ts">
    95→import { ref, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted, watch, nextTick } from 'vue'
    96→import { useRoute } from 'vue-router'
    97→import { createChart, CandlestickSeries, HistogramSeries, type IChartApi } from 'lightweight-charts'
    98→import client from '@/api/client'
    99→
   100→const route = useRoute()
   101→const ticker = route.params.ticker as string
   102→const chartContainer = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null)
   103→const stockName = ref('')
   104→
   105→// --- K線圖 ---
   106→const period = ref('3mo')
   107→const loading = ref(false)
   108→const error = ref('')
   109→const periods = [
   110→  { label: '1M', value: '1mo' },
   111→  { label: '3M', value: '3mo' },
   112→  { label: '6M', value: '6mo' },
   113→  { label: '1Y', value: '1y' },
   114→]
   115→
   116→// --- 壓力支撐 ---
   117→const chartType = ref<'candle' | 'profile'>('candle')
   118→const contentVisible = ref(true)
   119→const profilePeriod = ref('3mo')
   120→const profileLoading = ref(false)
   121→const profileError = ref('')
   122→const profileData = ref<{ label: string; price_low: number; price_high: number; volume: number; type: string }[]>([])
   123→const profilePeriods = [
   124→  { label: '近季', value: '3mo' },
   125→  { label: '近月', value: '1mo' },
   126→  { label: '近周', value: '5d' },
   127→]
   128→const profileMaxVolume = computed(() =>
   129→  profileData.value.reduce((max, r) => Math.max(max, r.volume), 1),
   130→)
   131→
   132→function formatVol(v: number): string {
   133→  if (v >= 1_000_000) return (v / 1_000_000).toFixed(1) + 'M'
   134→  if (v >= 1_000) return (v / 1_000).toFixed(0) + 'K'
   135→  return String(v)
   136→}
   137→
   138→// --- Lightweight chart ---
   139→let chart: IChartApi | null = null
   140→let candleSeries: any = null
   141→let volumeSeries: any = null
   142→
   143→async function loadChart() {
   144→  loading.value = true
   145→  error.value = ''
   146→  try {
   147→    const res = await client.get(`/stocks/${ticker}/chart`, { params: { period: period.value } })
   148→    const data = res.data
   149→    if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   150→      error.value = '查無資料'
   151→      return
   152→    }
   153→    if (candleSeries) candleSeries.setData(data)
   154→    if (volumeSeries) {
   155→      volumeSeries.setData(
   156→        data.map((d: any) => ({
   157→          time: d.time,
   158→          value: d.volume,
   159→          color: d.close >= d.open ? 'rgba(38, 166, 154, 0.5)' : 'rgba(239, 83, 80, 0.5)',
   160→        })),
   161→      )
   162→    }
   163→    chart?.timeScale().fitContent()
   164→  } catch (e: any) {
   165→    error.value = e?.response?.data?.detail ?? '載入失敗，請稍後再試'
   166→  } finally {
   167→    loading.value = false
   168→  }
   169→}
   170→
   171→async function loadProfile() {
   172→  profileLoading.value = true
   173→  profileError.value = ''
   174→  try {
   175→    const res = await client.get(`/stocks/${ticker}/volume-profile`, {
   176→      params: { period: profilePeriod.value },
   177→    })
   178→    profileData.value = res.data
   179→  } catch (e: any) {
   180→    profileError.value = e?.response?.data?.detail ?? '載入失敗，請稍後再試'
   181→  } finally {
   182→    profileLoading.value = false
   183→  }
   184→}
   185→
   186→async function loadStockName() {
   187→  try {
   188→    const res = await client.get('/stocks/search', { params: { q: ticker.replace('.TW', '').replace('.TWO', '') } })
   189→    const match = res.data.find((s: any) => s.ticker === ticker)
   190→    if (match) stockName.value = match.name
   191→  } catch {}
   192→}
   193→
   194→function changePeriod(p: string) {
   195→  period.value = p
   196→}
   197→
   198→function changeProfilePeriod(p: string) {
   199→  profilePeriod.value = p
   200→}
   201→
   202→function chartHeight() {
   203→  return window.innerWidth <= 640 ? 300 : 420
   204→}
   205→
   206→async function switchChartType(type: 'candle' | 'profile') {
   207→  if (type === chartType.value) return
   208→  // fade out
   209→  contentVisible.value = false
   210→  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 150))
   211→  // switch tab
   212→  chartType.value = type
   213→  if (type === 'profile' && profileData.value.length === 0) {
   214→    loadProfile()
   215→  }
   216→  if (type === 'candle') {
   217→    await nextTick()
   218→    if (chartContainer.value) {
   219→      chart?.resize(chartContainer.value.clientWidth, chartHeight())
   220→    }
   221→    chart?.timeScale().fitContent()
   222→  }
   223→  // fade in
   224→  await nextTick()
   225→  contentVisible.value = true
   226→}
   227→
   228→watch(period, loadChart)
   229→watch(profilePeriod, () => {
   230→  if (chartType.value === 'profile') loadProfile()
   231→})
   232→
   233→onMounted(async () => {
   234→  if (!chartContainer.value) return
   235→  loadStockName()
   236→
   237→  // 支援 ?tab=profile 直接切換到分價圖
   238→  if (route.query.tab === 'profile') {
   239→    chartType.value = 'profile'
   240→    loadProfile()
   241→  }
   242→
   243→  chart = createChart(chartContainer.value, {
   244→    height: chartHeight(),
   245→    layout: {
   246→      background: { color: '#0d1829' },
   247→      textColor: '#4a7aad',
   248→    },
   249→    grid: {
   250→      vertLines: { color: '#111f35' },
   251→      horzLines: { color: '#111f35' },
   252→    },
   253→    crosshair: {
   254→      vertLine: { color: '#1e3a5f', labelBackgroundColor: '#1e3a5f' },
   255→      horzLine: { color: '#1e3a5f', labelBackgroundColor: '#1e3a5f' },
   256→    },
   257→    timeScale: {
   258→      borderColor: '#1e3a5f',
   259→      timeVisible: true,
   260→    },
   261→    rightPriceScale: {
   262→      borderColor: '#1e3a5f',
   263→    },
   264→  })
   265→
   266→  candleSeries = chart.addSeries(CandlestickSeries, {
   267→    upColor: '#26a69a',
   268→    downColor: '#ef5350',
   269→    borderVisible: false,
   270→    wickUpColor: '#26a69a',
   271→    wickDownColor: '#ef5350',
   272→  })
   273→
   274→  volumeSeries = chart.addSeries(HistogramSeries, {
   275→    priceFormat: { type: 'volume' },
   276→    priceScaleId: 'volume',
   277→  })
   278→  chart.priceScale('volume').applyOptions({ scaleMargins: { top: 0.8, bottom: 0 } })
   279→
   280→  const handleResize = () => {
   281→    if (chartContainer.value) {
   282→      chart?.resize(chartContainer.value.clientWidth, chartHeight())
   283→    }
   284→  }
   285→  window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize)
   286→  onUnmounted(() => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize))
   287→
   288→  await loadChart()
   289→})
   290→
   291→onUnmounted(() => {
   292→  chart?.remove()
   293→})
   294→</script>
```

```text
   135→let searchTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null
   136→
   137→function onInput() {
   138→  activeSuggestion.value = -1
   139→  if (searchTimer) clearTimeout(searchTimer)
   140→  const q = query.value.trim()
   141→  if (q.length < 1) {
   142→    suggestions.value = []
   143→    return
   144→  }
   145→  searchTimer = setTimeout(async () => {
   146→    if (q.length < 2) return
   147→    searching.value = true
   148→    try {
   149→      const res = await client.get('/stocks/search', { params: { q } })
   150→      suggestions.value = res.data
   151→    } catch {
   152→      suggestions.value = []
   153→    } finally {
   154→      searching.value = false
   155→    }
   156→  }, 300)
   157→}
   158→
   159→function moveSuggestion(dir: number) {
   160→  const len = suggestions.value.length
   161→  if (!len) return
   162→  activeSuggestion.value = (activeSuggestion.value + dir + len) % len
   163→}
   164→
   165→async function selectSuggestion(idx: number) {
   166→  const s = idx >= 0 ? suggestions.value[idx] : suggestions.value[0]
   167→  if (!s) return
   168→  suggestions.value = []
   169→  query.value = `${s.code} ${s.name}`

   171→}

   173→async function loadStock(ticker: string) {
   174→  loading.value = true
   175→  error.value = ''
   176→  stockInfo.value = null
   177→  priceInfo.value = null
   178→  try {
   179→    const [infoRes, priceRes] = await Promise.all([
   180→      client.get(`/stocks/${ticker}/info`),
   181→      client.get(`/stocks/${ticker}/price`),
   182→    ])
   183→    stockInfo.value = infoRes.data
   184→    priceInfo.value = priceRes.data
   185→  } catch (e: any) {
   186→    error.value = e?.response?.data?.detail ?? '載入失敗，請稍後再試'
   187→  } finally {
   188→    loading.value = false
   189→  }
   190→}

   192→function formatMarketCap(val: number): string {
   193→  if (val >= 1e12) return (val / 1e12).toFixed(2) + ' 兆'
   194→  if (val >= 1e8) return (val / 1e8).toFixed(2) + ' 億'
   195→  if (val >= 1e4) return (val / 1e4).toFixed(2) + ' 萬'
   196→  return val.toLocaleString()
```

```python
import concurrent.futures
import json
import logging
import math
import os
import threading
import time
from typing import Callable, TypeVar

import yfinance as yf
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query

from auth import get_current_user
from stock_data import search_stocks

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/stocks", tags=["stocks"])

# ── 持久化快取 ────────────────────────────────────────────────
_CACHE_FILE = "/app/data/yf_cache.json"
_cache_lock = threading.Lock()
PRICE_TTL = 60
INFO_TTL = 3600


def _load_disk_cache() -> dict:
    try:
        with open(_CACHE_FILE) as f:
            return json.load(f)
    except (FileNotFoundError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return {"price": {}, "info": {}}


def _save_disk_cache(cache: dict) -> None:
    try:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(_CACHE_FILE), exist_ok=True)
        with open(_CACHE_FILE, "w") as f:
            json.dump(cache, f)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"Failed to save cache: {e}")


_disk_cache = _load_disk_cache()


def _get_cache(category: str, ticker: str, ttl: int):
    with _cache_lock:
        entry = _disk_cache.get(category, {}).get(ticker)
    if entry and time.time() - entry["ts"] < ttl:
        return entry["data"]
    return None


def _set_cache(category: str, ticker: str, data: dict) -> None:
    with _cache_lock:
        _disk_cache.setdefault(category, {})[ticker] = {"ts": time.time(), "data": data}
        _save_disk_cache(_disk_cache)


# ── Thread pool timeout ───────────────────────────────────────
T = TypeVar("T")
_executor = concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8)


def _run(fn: Callable[[], T], timeout: float = 12) -> T:
    future = _executor.submit(fn)
    try:
        return future.result(timeout=timeout)
    except concurrent.futures.TimeoutError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail="Upstream request timed out")


# ── 台股 tick size / bucket ───────────────────────────────────
def _tick_size(price: float) -> float:
    if price < 10:
        return 0.01
    elif price < 50:
        return 0.05
    elif price < 100:
        return 0.10
    elif price < 500:
        return 0.50
    elif price < 1000:
        return 1.00
    else:
        return 5.00


def _calc_bucket_size(min_price: float, max_price: float, target: int = 40) -> float:
    tick = _tick_size((min_price + max_price) / 2)
    ticks_per_bucket = max(1, math.ceil((max_price - min_price) / target / tick))
    return ticks_per_bucket * tick


VALID_PERIODS = {"5d", "1mo", "3mo", "6mo", "1y"}


# ── Routes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
@router.get("/search")
def search(
    q: str = Query(..., min_length=2),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    results = search_stocks(q, limit=10)
    return results


@router.get("/{ticker}/price")
def get_price(ticker: str, _: str = Depends(get_current_user)):
    cached = _get_cache("price", ticker, PRICE_TTL)
    if cached:
        return cached
    stale = _disk_cache.get("price", {}).get(ticker, {}).get("data")
    try:
        def _fetch():
            fi = yf.Ticker(ticker).fast_info
            return fi.last_price, fi.previous_close
        price, prev_close = _run(_fetch)
        if price is None or prev_close is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail="Stock data temporarily unavailable")
        change_percent = ((price - prev_close) / prev_close * 100) if prev_close else 0
        data = {
            "ticker": ticker,
            "price": round(price, 2),
            "change_percent": round(change_percent, 2),
        }
        _set_cache("price", ticker, data)
        return data
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to fetch price for {ticker}: {e}")
        if stale:
            logger.warning(f"Returning stale price cache for {ticker}")
            return stale
        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail="Failed to fetch stock price")


def _translate_summary(text: str) -> str:
    if not text:
        return text
    try:
        from deep_translator import GoogleTranslator
        return GoogleTranslator(source="en", target="zh-TW").translate(text, timeout=5)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"Translation failed, returning original: {e}")
        return text


@router.get("/{ticker}/info")
def get_info(ticker: str, _: str = Depends(get_current_user)):
    cached = _get_cache("info", ticker, INFO_TTL)
    if cached:
        return cached
    stale = _disk_cache.get("info", {}).get(ticker, {}).get("data")
    try:
        info = _run(lambda: yf.Ticker(ticker).info)
        if not info:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail="Stock data temporarily unavailable")
        summary_en = info.get("longBusinessSummary", "")
        data = {
            "ticker": ticker,
            "name": info.get("longName") or info.get("shortName", ""),
            "sector": info.get("sector", ""),
            "industry": info.get("industry", ""),
            "country": info.get("country", ""),
            "website": info.get("website", ""),
            "employees": info.get("fullTimeEmployees"),
            "market_cap": info.get("marketCap"),
            "currency": info.get("currency", ""),
            "summary": _run(lambda: _translate_summary(summary_en), timeout=6),
        }
        _set_cache("info", ticker, data)
        return data
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to fetch info for {ticker}: {e}")
        if stale:
            logger.warning(f"Returning stale info cache for {ticker}")
            return stale
        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail="Failed to fetch stock info")


@router.get("/{ticker}/chart")
def get_chart(
    ticker: str,
    period: str = Query(default="3mo"),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    if period not in VALID_PERIODS:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail=f"Invalid period. Must be one of: {', '.join(sorted(VALID_PERIODS))}",
        )
    try:
        df = _run(lambda: yf.Ticker(ticker).history(period=period))
        if df.empty:
            return []
        records = []
        for ts, row in df.iterrows():
            records.append({
                "time": ts.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
                "open": round(float(row["Open"]), 2),
                "high": round(float(row["High"]), 2),
                "low": round(float(row["Low"]), 2),
                "close": round(float(row["Close"]), 2),
                "volume": int(row["Volume"]),
            })
        return records
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to fetch chart for {ticker}: {e}")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail="Failed to fetch chart data")


@router.get("/{ticker}/volume-profile")
def get_volume_profile(
    ticker: str,
    period: str = Query(default="3mo"),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    if period not in VALID_PERIODS:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail=f"Invalid period. Must be one of: {', '.join(sorted(VALID_PERIODS))}",
        )
    try:
        def _fetch_profile():
            tk = yf.Ticker(ticker)
            df = tk.history(period=period)
            price = tk.fast_info.last_price if not df.empty else None
            return df, price
        df, current_price = _run(_fetch_profile)
        if df.empty:
            return []
        min_price = float(df["Low"].min())
        max_price = float(df["High"].max())
        bucket_size = _calc_bucket_size(min_price, max_price)
        num_buckets = math.ceil((max_price - min_price) / bucket_size)

        volumes = [0.0] * num_buckets
        for _, row in df.iterrows():
            typical = (float(row["High"]) + float(row["Low"]) + float(row["Close"])) / 3
            idx = int((typical - min_price) / bucket_size)
            idx = min(idx, num_buckets - 1)
            volumes[idx] += float(row["Volume"])

        result = []
        for i in range(num_buckets - 1, -1, -1):
            low = round(min_price + i * bucket_size, 2)
            high = round(min_price + (i + 1) * bucket_size, 2)
            if low <= current_price < high:
                bar_type = "價"
            elif high <= current_price:
                bar_type = "支撐"
            else:
                bar_type = "壓力"
            result.append({
                "label": f"{low:.2f}~{high:.2f}",
                "price_low": low,
                "price_high": high,
                "volume": int(volumes[i]),
                "type": bar_type,
            })

        return result
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to fetch volume profile for {ticker}: {e}")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail="Failed to fetch volume profile")
```
